newsitem.title: MEXICO: Kodak sees $100 mln '97 Mexico investment.
newsitem.headline: Kodak sees $100 mln '97 Mexico investment.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co's Mexican arm has earmarked $100 million for investment in Mexico in 1997, the company chairman told journalists on Monday.
"Investment plans ... will be for more than $100 million in the country this year," said Charles Griffin, chairman of Kodak de Mexico.
Griffin said the investment would be channeled mainly into the company's plant in the western state of Jalisco, into producing recordable compact discs and disposable cameras.
Kodak aimed to produce 18 million recordable compact discs worldwide per year by 1998, mostly at the company's Guadalajara plant, Griffin said.
